newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Wendy's to open Venezuela outlet - report.
newsitem.headline: Wendy's to open Venezuela outlet - report.

text.p: Wendy's International Inc, through its Wenco Servicios de Comida Rapida CA unit, will open its first restaurant in Venezuela in August, Wenco Executive President Andres Garcia said, according to a newspaper report.
The outlet will be one of seven Wendy's that will open this year, all in the capital, Garcia was quoted as saying by local daily El Universal.
Further restaurants will be opened in other parts of the country in 1998 with a target of 50 to be opened over the next three years.
Of this total, 23 will be converted outlets of local fast food chain TropiBurger as part of a franchise agreement signed in February, Garcia said.
Wendy's main competitor in the Venezuelan market will be McDonald's Corp.
